verses.original: Ἐν οἷς ἐπισυναχθεισῶν τῶν μυριάδων τοῦ ὄχλου ὥστε καταπατεῖν ἀλλήλους ἤρξατο λέγειν πρὸς τοὺς μαθητὰς αὐτοῦ πρῶτον Προσέχετε ἑαυτοῖς ἀπὸ τῆς ζύμης ἥτις ἐστὶν ὑπόκρισις τῶν Φαρισαίων
verses.transliteration: En hois episynachtheisōn tōn myriadōn tou ochlou hōste katapatein allēlous ērxato legein pros tous mathētas autou prōton Prosechete heautois apo tēs zymēs hētis estin hypokrisis tōn Pharisaiōn
verses.literal: In the meantime a crowd of many thousands had gathered so that they were trampling one another Jesus began to speak first to His disciples Beware . . . of the leaven of the Pharisees which is hypocrisy

verses.original: οὐδὲν δὲ συγκεκαλυμμένον ἐστὶν ὃ οὐκ ἀποκαλυφθήσεται καὶ κρυπτὸν ὃ οὐ γνωσθήσεται
verses.transliteration: ouden de synkekalymmenon estin ho ouk apokalyphthēsetai kai krypton ho ou gnōsthēsetai
verses.literal: There is nothing concealed that will not be disclosed and nothing hidden that will not be made known

verses.original: ἀνθ’ ὧν ὅσα ἐν τῇ σκοτίᾳ εἴπατε ἐν τῷ φωτὶ ἀκουσθήσεται καὶ ὃ πρὸς τὸ οὖς ἐλαλήσατε ἐν τοῖς ταμείοις κηρυχθήσεται ἐπὶ τῶν δωμάτων
verses.transliteration: anth’ hōn hosa en tē skotia eipate en tō phōti akousthēsetai kai ho pros to ous elalēsate en tois tameiois kērychthēsetai epi tōn dōmatōn
verses.literal: What . . . you have spoken in the dark will be heard in the daylight and what you have whispered . . . . . . . . . in the inner rooms will be proclaimed from the housetops

verses.original: Λέγω δὲ ὑμῖν τοῖς φίλοις μου μὴ φοβηθῆτε ἀπὸ τῶν ἀποκτεινόντων τὸ σῶμα καὶ μετὰ ταῦτα μὴ ἐχόντων περισσότερόν τι ποιῆσαι
verses.transliteration: Legō de hymin tois philois mou mē phobēthēte apo tōn apokteinontōn to sōma kai meta tauta mē echontōn perissoteron ti poiēsai
verses.literal: I tell you My friends do not be afraid of those who kill the body and after that can do no more

verses.original: ὑποδείξω δὲ ὑμῖν τίνα φοβηθῆτε φοβήθητε τὸν μετὰ τὸ ἀποκτεῖναι ἔχοντα ἐξουσίαν ἐμβαλεῖν εἰς τὴν γέενναν ναί λέγω ὑμῖν τοῦτον φοβήθητε
verses.transliteration: hypodeixō de hymin tina phobēthēte phobēthēte ton meta to apokteinai echonta exousian embalein eis tēn geennan nai legō hymin touton phobēthēte
verses.literal: But I will show you whom you should fear Fear the One who after you have been killed has authority to throw you into hell Yes I tell you fear Him

verses.original: Οὐχὶ πέντε στρουθία πωλοῦνται ἀσσαρίων δύο καὶ ἓν ἐξ αὐτῶν οὐκ ἔστιν ἐπιλελησμένον ἐνώπιον τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Ouchi pente strouthia pōlountai assariōn dyo kai hen ex autōn ouk estin epilelēsmenon enōpion tou Theou
verses.literal: Are not five sparrows sold for two pennies Yet not one of them is forgotten by God

verses.original: ἀλλὰ καὶ αἱ τρίχες τῆς κεφαλῆς ὑμῶν πᾶσαι ἠρίθμηνται μὴ φοβεῖσθε πολλῶν στρουθίων διαφέρετε
verses.transliteration: alla kai hai triches tēs kephalēs hymōn pasai ērithmēntai mē phobeisthe pollōn strouthiōn diapherete
verses.literal: And even the very hairs of your head are all numbered So do not be afraid you are worth more than many sparrows

verses.original: Λέγω δὲ ὑμῖν πᾶς ὃς ἂν ὁμολογήσῃ ἐν ἐμοὶ ἔμπροσθεν τῶν ἀνθρώπων καὶ ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ὁμολογήσει ἐν αὐτῷ ἔμπροσθεν τῶν ἀγγέλων τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Legō de hymin pas hos an homologēsē en emoi emprosthen tōn anthrōpōn kai ho Huios tou anthrōpou homologēsei en autō emprosthen tōn angelōn tou Theou
verses.literal: I tell you everyone who confesses . . . Me before men the Son of Man will also confess . . . him before the angels of God

verses.original: ὁ δὲ ἀρνησάμενός με ἐνώπιον τῶν ἀνθρώπων ἀπαρνηθήσεται ἐνώπιον τῶν ἀγγέλων τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: ho de arnēsamenos me enōpion tōn anthrōpōn aparnēthēsetai enōpion tōn angelōn tou Theou
verses.literal: But whoever denies Me before men will be denied before the angels of God

verses.original: καὶ πᾶς ὃς ἐρεῖ λόγον εἰς τὸν Υἱὸν τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἀφεθήσεται αὐτῷ τῷ δὲ εἰς τὸ Ἅγιον Πνεῦμα βλασφημήσαντι οὐκ ἀφεθήσεται
verses.transliteration: kai pas hos erei logon eis ton Huion tou anthrōpou aphethēsetai autō tō de eis to Hagion Pneuma blasphēmēsanti ouk aphethēsetai
verses.literal: And everyone who speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven . . . but whoever blasphemes against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven

verses.original: Ὅταν δὲ εἰσφέρωσιν ὑμᾶς ἐπὶ τὰς συναγωγὰς καὶ τὰς ἀρχὰς καὶ τὰς ἐξουσίας μὴ μεριμνήσητε πῶς ἢ τί ἀπολογήσησθε ἢ τί εἴπητε
verses.transliteration: Hotan de eispherōsin hymas epi tas synagōgas kai tas archas kai tas exousias mē merimnēsēte pōs ē ti apologēsēsthe ē ti eipēte
verses.literal: When you are brought before synagogues - rulers and authorities do not worry about how . . . . . . to defend yourselves or what to say

verses.original: τὸ γὰρ Ἅγιον Πνεῦμα διδάξει ὑμᾶς ἐν αὐτῇ τῇ ὥρᾳ ἃ δεῖ εἰπεῖν
verses.transliteration: to gar Hagion Pneuma didaxei hymas en autē tē hōra ha dei eipein
verses.literal: For at that time the Holy Spirit will teach you what you should say

verses.original: Εἶπεν δέ τις ἐκ τοῦ ὄχλου αὐτῷ Διδάσκαλε εἰπὲ τῷ ἀδελφῷ μου μερίσασθαι μετ’ ἐμοῦ τὴν κληρονομίαν
verses.transliteration: Eipen de tis ek tou ochlou autō Didaskale eipe tō adelphō mou merisasthai met’ emou tēn klēronomian
verses.literal: Someone in the crowd said to Him Teacher tell . . . my brother to divide the inheritance with me

verses.original: Ὁ δὲ εἶπεν αὐτῷ Ἄνθρωπε τίς με κατέστησεν κριτὴν ἢ μεριστὴν ἐφ’ ὑμᾶς
verses.transliteration: Ho de eipen autō Anthrōpe tis me katestēsen kritēn ē meristēn eph’ hymas
verses.literal: But Jesus replied . . . Man who appointed Me judge or executor between you

verses.original: εἶπεν δὲ πρὸς αὐτούς Ὁρᾶτε καὶ φυλάσσεσθε ἀπὸ πάσης πλεονεξίας ὅτι οὐκ ἐν τῷ περισσεύειν τινὶ ἡ ζωὴ αὐτοῦ ἐστιν ἐκ τῶν ὑπαρχόντων αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: eipen de pros autous Horate kai phylassesthe apo pasēs pleonexias hoti ouk en tō perisseuein tini hē zōē autou estin ek tōn hyparchontōn autō
verses.literal: And He said to them Watch out Guard yourselves against every form of greed for one’s . . . life does not consist in the abundance of his possessions

verses.original: Εἶπεν δὲ παραβολὴν πρὸς αὐτοὺς λέγων Ἀνθρώπου τινὸς πλουσίου εὐφόρησεν ἡ χώρα
verses.transliteration: Eipen de parabolēn pros autous legōn Anthrōpou tinos plousiou euphorēsen hē chōra
verses.literal: Then He told . . . them a parable The ground of a certain rich man produced an abundance

verses.original: καὶ διελογίζετο ἐν ἑαυτῷ λέγων Τί ποιήσω ὅτι οὐκ ἔχω ποῦ συνάξω τοὺς καρπούς μου
verses.transliteration: kai dielogizeto en heautō legōn Ti poiēsō hoti ouk echō pou synaxō tous karpous mou
verses.literal: So he thought to himself What shall I do since I have nowhere . . . to store my crops

verses.original: καὶ εἶπεν Τοῦτο ποιήσω καθελῶ μου τὰς ἀποθήκας καὶ μείζονας οἰκοδομήσω καὶ συνάξω ἐκεῖ πάντα τὸν σῖτον καὶ τὰ ἀγαθά μου
verses.transliteration: kai eipen Touto poiēsō kathelō mou tas apothēkas kai meizonas oikodomēsō kai synaxō ekei panta ton siton kai ta agatha mou
verses.literal: Then he said This is what I will do I will tear down my barns and will build bigger ones and there I will store up all my grain and my goods

verses.original: καὶ ἐρῶ τῇ ψυχῇ μου Ψυχή ἔχεις πολλὰ ἀγαθὰ κείμενα εἰς ἔτη πολλά ἀναπαύου φάγε πίε εὐφραίνου
verses.transliteration: kai erō tē psychē mou Psychē echeis polla agatha keimena eis etē polla anapauou phage pie euphrainou
verses.literal: Then I will say to myself . . . You have plenty of good things laid up for many years Take it easy Eat drink and be merry

verses.original: Εἶπεν δὲ αὐτῷ ὁ Θεός Ἄφρων ταύτῃ τῇ νυκτὶ τὴν ψυχήν σου ἀπαιτοῦσιν ἀπὸ σοῦ ἃ δὲ ἡτοίμασας τίνι ἔσται
verses.transliteration: Eipen de autō ho Theos Aphrōn tautē tē nykti tēn psychēn sou apaitousin apo sou ha de hētoimasas tini estai
verses.literal: But God said to him You fool This very night your life will be required of you Then who will own what you have accumulated

verses.original: Οὕτως ὁ θησαυρίζων ἑαυτῷ καὶ μὴ εἰς Θεὸν πλουτῶν
verses.transliteration: Houtōs ho thēsaurizōn heautō kai mē eis Theon ploutōn
verses.literal: This is how it will be for anyone who stores up treasure for himself but is not rich toward God

verses.original: Εἶπεν δὲ πρὸς τοὺς μαθητὰς αὐτοῦ Διὰ τοῦτο λέγω ὑμῖν μὴ μεριμνᾶτε τῇ ψυχῇ τί φάγητε μηδὲ τῷ σώματι ὑμῶν τί ἐνδύσησθε
verses.transliteration: Eipen de pros tous mathētas autou Dia touto legō hymin mē merimnate tē psychē ti phagēte mēde tō sōmati hymōn ti endysēsthe
verses.literal: Then Jesus said to His disciples Therefore . . . I tell you do not worry about your life what you will eat or about your body what you will wear

verses.original: ἡ γὰρ ψυχὴ πλεῖόν ἐστιν τῆς τροφῆς καὶ τὸ σῶμα τοῦ ἐνδύματος
verses.transliteration: hē gar psychē pleion estin tēs trophēs kai to sōma tou endymatos
verses.literal: For life is more than food and the body more than clothes

verses.original: κατανοήσατε τοὺς κόρακας ὅτι οὐ σπείρουσιν οὐδὲ θερίζουσιν οἷς οὐκ ἔστιν ταμεῖον οὐδὲ ἀποθήκη καὶ ὁ Θεὸς τρέφει αὐτούς πόσῳ μᾶλλον ὑμεῖς διαφέρετε τῶν πετεινῶν
verses.transliteration: katanoēsate tous korakas hoti ou speirousin oude therizousin hois ouk estin tameion oude apothēkē kai ho Theos trephei autous posō mallon hymeis diapherete tōn peteinōn
verses.literal: Consider the ravens They do not sow or reap they have no storehouse or barn yet God feeds them How much more valuable you are than the birds

verses.original: τίς δὲ ἐξ ὑμῶν μεριμνῶν δύναται ἐπὶ τὴν ἡλικίαν αὐτοῦ προσθεῖναι πῆχυν
verses.transliteration: tis de ex hymōn merimnōn dynatai epi tēn hēlikian autou prostheinai pēchyn
verses.literal: Who of you by worrying can add a single hour to his life

verses.original: εἰ οὖν οὐδὲ ἐλάχιστον δύνασθε τί περὶ τῶν λοιπῶν μεριμνᾶτε
verses.transliteration: ei oun oude elachiston dynasthe ti peri tōn loipōn merimnate
verses.literal: So if you cannot do such a small thing why do you worry about the rest

verses.original: Κατανοήσατε τὰ κρίνα πῶς αὐξάνει οὐ κοπιᾷ οὐδὲ νήθει λέγω δὲ ὑμῖν οὐδὲ Σολομὼν ἐν πάσῃ τῇ δόξῃ αὐτοῦ περιεβάλετο ὡς ἓν τούτων
verses.transliteration: Katanoēsate ta krina pōs auxanei ou kopia oude nēthei legō de hymin oude Solomōn en pasē tē doxē autou periebaleto hōs hen toutōn
verses.literal: Consider how the lilies grow They do not labor or spin Yet I tell you not even Solomon in all his glory was adorned like one of these

verses.original: εἰ δὲ ἐν ἀγρῷ τὸν χόρτον ὄντα σήμερον καὶ αὔριον εἰς κλίβανον βαλλόμενον ὁ Θεὸς οὕτως ἀμφιέζει πόσῳ μᾶλλον ὑμᾶς ὀλιγόπιστοι
verses.transliteration: ei de en agrō ton chorton onta sēmeron kai aurion eis klibanon ballomenon ho Theos houtōs amphiezei posō mallon hymas oligopistoi
verses.literal: If that is how God clothes the grass of the field which is here today and tomorrow is thrown into the furnace how much more will He clothe you O you of little faith

verses.original: Καὶ ὑμεῖς μὴ ζητεῖτε τί φάγητε καὶ τί πίητε καὶ μὴ μετεωρίζεσθε
verses.transliteration: Kai hymeis mē zēteite ti phagēte kai ti piēte kai mē meteōrizesthe
verses.literal: And do not be concerned about what you will eat or drink Do not worry about it

verses.original: ταῦτα γὰρ πάντα τὰ ἔθνη τοῦ κόσμου ἐπιζητοῦσιν ὑμῶν δὲ ὁ Πατὴρ οἶδεν ὅτι χρῄζετε τούτων
verses.transliteration: tauta gar panta ta ethnē tou kosmou epizētousin hymōn de ho Patēr oiden hoti chrēzete toutōn
verses.literal: For the Gentiles of the world strive after all these things and your Father knows that you need them

verses.original: πλὴν ζητεῖτε τὴν βασιλείαν αὐτοῦ καὶ ταῦτα προστεθήσεται ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: plēn zēteite tēn basileian autou kai tauta prostethēsetai hymin
verses.literal: But seek His kingdom and these things will be added unto you

verses.original: Μὴ φοβοῦ τὸ μικρὸν ποίμνιον ὅτι εὐδόκησεν ὁ Πατὴρ ὑμῶν δοῦναι ὑμῖν τὴν βασιλείαν
verses.transliteration: Mē phobou to mikron poimnion hoti eudokēsen ho Patēr hymōn dounai hymin tēn basileian
verses.literal: Do not be afraid little flock for your Father is pleased to give you the kingdom

verses.original: Πωλήσατε τὰ ὑπάρχοντα ὑμῶν καὶ δότε ἐλεημοσύνην ποιήσατε ἑαυτοῖς βαλλάντια μὴ παλαιούμενα θησαυρὸν ἀνέκλειπτον ἐν τοῖς οὐρανοῖς ὅπου κλέπτης οὐκ ἐγγίζει οὐδὲ σὴς διαφθείρει
verses.transliteration: Pōlēsate ta hyparchonta hymōn kai dote eleēmosynēn poiēsate heautois ballantia mē palaioumena thēsauron anekleipton en tois ouranois hopou kleptēs ouk engizei oude sēs diaphtheirei
verses.literal: Sell your possessions and give to the poor Provide yourselves with purses that will not wear out an inexhaustible treasure in heaven where no thief approaches and no moth destroys

verses.original: ὅπου γάρ ἐστιν ὁ θησαυρὸς ὑμῶν ἐκεῖ καὶ ἡ καρδία ὑμῶν ἔσται
verses.transliteration: hopou gar estin ho thēsauros hymōn ekei kai hē kardia hymōn estai
verses.literal: For where your treasure is there your heart will be also

verses.original: Ἔστωσαν ὑμῶν αἱ ὀσφύες περιεζωσμέναι καὶ οἱ λύχνοι καιόμενοι
verses.transliteration: Estōsan hymōn hai osphyes periezōsmenai kai hoi lychnoi kaiomenoi
verses.literal: Be dressed for service . . . . . . . . . and keep your lamps burning

verses.original: καὶ ὑμεῖς ὅμοιοι ἀνθρώποις προσδεχομένοις τὸν κύριον ἑαυτῶν πότε ἀναλύσῃ ἐκ τῶν γάμων ἵνα ἐλθόντος καὶ κρούσαντος εὐθέως ἀνοίξωσιν αὐτῷ
verses.transliteration: kai hymeis homoioi anthrōpois prosdechomenois ton kyrion heautōn pote analysē ek tōn gamōn hina elthontos kai krousantos eutheōs anoixōsin autō
verses.literal: Then you will be like servants waiting for their master to return from the wedding banquet so that when he comes and knocks they can open the door for him at once

verses.original: μακάριοι οἱ δοῦλοι ἐκεῖνοι οὓς ἐλθὼν ὁ κύριος εὑρήσει γρηγοροῦντας ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι περιζώσεται καὶ ἀνακλινεῖ αὐτοὺς καὶ παρελθὼν διακονήσει αὐτοῖς
verses.transliteration: makarioi hoi douloi ekeinoi hous elthōn ho kyrios heurēsei grēgorountas amēn legō hymin hoti perizōsetai kai anaklinei autous kai parelthōn diakonēsei autois
verses.literal: Blessed are those servants whom the master finds on watch when he returns Truly I tell you he will dress himself to serve and . . . will have them recline at the table and he himself will come and wait on them

verses.original: κἂν ἐν τῇ δευτέρᾳ κἂν ἐν τῇ τρίτῃ φυλακῇ ἔλθῃ καὶ εὕρῃ οὕτως μακάριοί εἰσιν ἐκεῖνοι
verses.transliteration: kan en tē deutera kan en tē tritē phylakē elthē kai heurē houtōs makarioi eisin ekeinoi
verses.literal: Even if he comes in the second or - third watch of the night and finds them alert those servants will be blessed

verses.original: Τοῦτο δὲ γινώσκετε ὅτι εἰ ᾔδει ὁ οἰκοδεσπότης ποίᾳ ὥρᾳ ὁ κλέπτης ἔρχεται οὐκ ἂν ἀφῆκεν διορυχθῆναι τὸν οἶκον αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Touto de ginōskete hoti ei ēdei ho oikodespotēs poia hōra ho kleptēs erchetai ouk an aphēken diorychthēnai ton oikon autou
verses.literal: But understand this If the homeowner had known at what hour the thief was coming he would not have let his house be broken into

verses.original: καὶ ὑμεῖς γίνεσθε ἕτοιμοι ὅτι ᾗ ὥρᾳ οὐ δοκεῖτε ὁ Υἱὸς τοῦ ἀνθρώπου ἔρχεται
verses.transliteration: kai hymeis ginesthe hetoimoi hoti hē hōra ou dokeite ho Huios tou anthrōpou erchetai
verses.literal: You also must be ready because the Son of Man will come at an hour you do not expect

verses.original: Εἶπεν δὲ ὁ Πέτρος Κύριε πρὸς ἡμᾶς τὴν παραβολὴν ταύτην λέγεις ἢ καὶ πρὸς πάντας
verses.transliteration: Eipen de ho Petros Kyrie pros hēmas tēn parabolēn tautēn legeis ē kai pros pantas
verses.literal: Lord - said Peter are You addressing this parable to us or to everyone else as well

verses.original: Καὶ εἶπεν ὁ Κύριος Τίς ἄρα ἐστὶν ὁ πιστὸς οἰκονόμος ὁ φρόνιμος ὃν καταστήσει ὁ κύριος ἐπὶ τῆς θεραπείας αὐτοῦ τοῦ διδόναι ἐν καιρῷ τὸ σιτομέτριον
verses.transliteration: Kai eipen ho Kyrios Tis ara estin ho pistos oikonomos ho phronimos hon katastēsei ho kyrios epi tēs therapeias autou tou didonai en kairō to sitometrion
verses.literal: And the Lord answered Who then is the faithful and wise manager whom the master puts in charge of his servants to give them their portion at the proper time

verses.original: μακάριος ὁ δοῦλος ἐκεῖνος ὃν ἐλθὼν ὁ κύριος αὐτοῦ εὑρήσει ποιοῦντα οὕτως
verses.transliteration: makarios ho doulos ekeinos hon elthōn ho kyrios autou heurēsei poiounta houtōs
verses.literal: Blessed is that servant whose - master finds him doing so when he returns

verses.original: ἀληθῶς λέγω ὑμῖν ὅτι ἐπὶ πᾶσιν τοῖς ὑπάρχουσιν αὐτοῦ καταστήσει αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: alēthōs legō hymin hoti epi pasin tois hyparchousin autou katastēsei auton
verses.literal: Truly I tell you he will put him in charge . . . of all his possessions

verses.original: Ἐὰν δὲ εἴπῃ ὁ δοῦλος ἐκεῖνος ἐν τῇ καρδίᾳ αὐτοῦ Χρονίζει ὁ κύριός μου ἔρχεσθαι καὶ ἄρξηται τύπτειν τοὺς παῖδας καὶ τὰς παιδίσκας ἐσθίειν τε καὶ πίνειν καὶ μεθύσκεσθαι
verses.transliteration: Ean de eipē ho doulos ekeinos en tē kardia autou Chronizei ho kyrios mou erchesthai kai arxētai typtein tous paidas kai tas paidiskas esthiein te kai pinein kai methyskesthai
verses.literal: But suppose that servant says in his heart My master will be a long time in coming and he begins to beat the menservants and maidservants and to eat and drink and get drunk

verses.original: ἥξει ὁ κύριος τοῦ δούλου ἐκείνου ἐν ἡμέρᾳ ᾗ οὐ προσδοκᾷ καὶ ἐν ὥρᾳ ᾗ οὐ γινώσκει καὶ διχοτομήσει αὐτὸν καὶ τὸ μέρος αὐτοῦ μετὰ τῶν ἀπίστων θήσει
verses.transliteration: hēxei ho kyrios tou doulou ekeinou en hēmera hē ou prosdoka kai en hōra hē ou ginōskei kai dichotomēsei auton kai to meros autou meta tōn apistōn thēsei
verses.literal: The master of that servant will come on a day he does not expect and at an hour he does not anticipate Then he will cut him to pieces . . . and assign him a place with the unbelievers

verses.original: Ἐκεῖνος δὲ ὁ δοῦλος ὁ γνοὺς τὸ θέλημα τοῦ κυρίου αὐτοῦ καὶ μὴ ἑτοιμάσας ἢ ποιήσας πρὸς τὸ θέλημα αὐτοῦ δαρήσεται πολλάς
verses.transliteration: Ekeinos de ho doulos ho gnous to thelēma tou kyriou autou kai mē hetoimasas ē poiēsas pros to thelēma autou darēsetai pollas
verses.literal: That servant who knows his master’s will but does not get ready or follow . . . his instructions will be beaten with many blows

verses.original: ὁ δὲ μὴ γνοὺς ποιήσας δὲ ἄξια πληγῶν δαρήσεται ὀλίγας παντὶ δὲ ᾧ ἐδόθη πολύ πολὺ ζητηθήσεται παρ’ αὐτοῦ καὶ ᾧ παρέθεντο πολύ περισσότερον αἰτήσουσιν αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: ho de mē gnous poiēsas de axia plēgōn darēsetai oligas panti de hō edothē poly poly zētēthēsetai par’ autou kai hō parethento poly perissoteron aitēsousin auton
verses.literal: But the one who unknowingly does things worthy of punishment will be beaten with few blows From everyone who has been given much much will be required and from him who has been entrusted with much even more will be demanded . . .

verses.original: Πῦρ ἦλθον βαλεῖν ἐπὶ τὴν γῆν καὶ τί θέλω εἰ ἤδη ἀνήφθη
verses.transliteration: Pyr ēlthon balein epi tēn gēn kai ti thelō ei ēdē anēphthē
verses.literal: I have come to ignite a fire on the earth and how I wish it were already kindled . . .

verses.original: βάπτισμα δὲ ἔχω βαπτισθῆναι καὶ πῶς συνέχομαι ἕως ὅτου τελεσθῇ
verses.transliteration: baptisma de echō baptisthēnai kai pōs synechomai heōs hotou telesthē
verses.literal: But I have a baptism to undergo and how distressed I am until . . . it is accomplished

verses.original: Δοκεῖτε ὅτι εἰρήνην παρεγενόμην δοῦναι ἐν τῇ γῇ οὐχί λέγω ὑμῖν ἀλλ’ ἢ διαμερισμόν
verses.transliteration: Dokeite hoti eirēnēn paregenomēn dounai en tē gē ouchi legō hymin all’ ē diamerismon
verses.literal: Do you think that I have come to bring peace to the earth No I tell you but . . . division

verses.original: ἔσονται γὰρ ἀπὸ τοῦ νῦν πέντε ἐν ἑνὶ οἴκῳ διαμεμερισμένοι τρεῖς ἐπὶ δυσὶν καὶ δύο ἐπὶ τρισίν
verses.transliteration: esontai gar apo tou nyn pente en heni oikō diamemerismenoi treis epi dysin kai dyo epi trisin
verses.literal: From now on five in one household will be divided three against two and two against three

verses.original: διαμερισθήσονται πατὴρ ἐπὶ υἱῷ καὶ υἱὸς ἐπὶ πατρί μήτηρ ἐπὶ τὴν θυγατέρα καὶ θυγάτηρ ἐπὶ τὴν μητέρα πενθερὰ ἐπὶ τὴν νύμφην αὐτῆς καὶ νύμφη ἐπὶ τὴν πενθεράν
verses.transliteration: diameristhēsontai patēr epi huiō kai huios epi patri mētēr epi tēn thygatera kai thygatēr epi tēn mētera penthera epi tēn nymphēn autēs kai nymphē epi tēn pentheran
verses.literal: They will be divided father against son and son against father mother against daughter and daughter against mother mother-in-law against - daughter-in-law and daughter-in-law against mother-in-law

verses.original: Ἔλεγεν δὲ καὶ τοῖς ὄχλοις Ὅταν ἴδητε τὴν νεφέλην ἀνατέλλουσαν ἐπὶ δυσμῶν εὐθέως λέγετε ὅτι Ὄμβρος ἔρχεται καὶ γίνεται οὕτως
verses.transliteration: Elegen de kai tois ochlois Hotan idēte tēn nephelēn anatellousan epi dysmōn eutheōs legete hoti Ombros erchetai kai ginetai houtōs
verses.literal: Then Jesus said to the crowds As soon as . . . you see a cloud rising in the west you say A shower is coming and that is what happens

verses.original: καὶ ὅταν νότον πνέοντα λέγετε ὅτι Καύσων ἔσται καὶ γίνεται
verses.transliteration: kai hotan noton pneonta legete hoti Kausōn estai kai ginetai
verses.literal: And when the south wind blows you say It will be hot and it is

verses.original: ὑποκριταί τὸ πρόσωπον τῆς γῆς καὶ τοῦ οὐρανοῦ οἴδατε δοκιμάζειν τὸν καιρὸν δὲ τοῦτον πῶς οὐκ οἴδατε δοκιμάζειν
verses.transliteration: hypokritai to prosōpon tēs gēs kai tou ouranou oidate dokimazein ton kairon de touton pōs ouk oidate dokimazein
verses.literal: You hypocrites You know how to interpret the appearance of the earth and sky Why don’t you know how to interpret the present time

verses.original: Τί δὲ καὶ ἀφ’ ἑαυτῶν οὐ κρίνετε τὸ δίκαιον
verses.transliteration: Ti de kai aph’ heautōn ou krinete to dikaion
verses.literal: And why don’t you judge for yourselves what is right

verses.original: ὡς γὰρ ὑπάγεις μετὰ τοῦ ἀντιδίκου σου ἐπ’ ἄρχοντα ἐν τῇ ὁδῷ δὸς ἐργασίαν ἀπηλλάχθαι ἀπ’ αὐτοῦ μή‿ ποτε κατασύρῃ σε πρὸς τὸν κριτήν καὶ ὁ κριτής σε παραδώσει τῷ πράκτορι καὶ ὁ πράκτωρ σε βαλεῖ εἰς φυλακήν
verses.transliteration: hōs gar hypageis meta tou antidikou sou ep’ archonta en tē hodō dos ergasian apēllachthai ap’ autou mē pote katasyrē se pros ton kritēn kai ho kritēs se paradōsei tō praktori kai ho praktōr se balei eis phylakēn
verses.literal: Make every effort to reconcile with your adversary while you are on your way . . . . . . . . . to the magistrate Otherwise . . . he may drag you off . . . to the judge and the judge may hand you over to the officer and the officer may throw you into prison

verses.original: λέγω σοι οὐ μὴ ἐξέλθῃς ἐκεῖθεν ἕως καὶ τὸ ἔσχατον λεπτὸν ἀποδῷς
verses.transliteration: legō soi ou mē exelthēs ekeithen heōs kai to eschaton lepton apodōs
verses.literal: I tell you you will not get out . . . until you have paid the very last penny
